name: a first-look marker keeps an event that began before the visible range from accusing an agent
notes: §3 v1.10: every row a Calendar pass stores as a first sighting (an event its base could not have seen) gets a first-look marker, written by the ledger with the row: a gcal.event entry of the same observer and account whose window is the row's occurredAt (a point) and whose lastSyncAt and changesSince are the row's first sighting. Under orphan rule (b) the marker found the row already there, so the row is never an orphan; a point never makes coverage full (§6.1).

Coverage. acct-a follows the week [09-27 00:00, 10-04 00:00]: changesSince 09:00, last synced 14:20 (its passes, merged). acct-b first looks at the week [10-04 00:00, 10-11 00:00] at 14:10: a complete first look, changesSince = lastSyncAt = 14:10. acct-b's marker for o1: window [10-02 09:00, 10-02 09:00], changesSince = lastSyncAt = 14:10. No claims.

o1 'Conference' starts 10-02 09:00 and runs into acct-b's week, so acct-b's first look at 14:10 shows it (a multi-day chip) and stores it as a first sighting at 14:10. Its start lies before acct-b's window: no window of acct-b holds it.

o1 (§3): the gcal.event entries holding 10-02 09:00 are acct-a's (changesSince 09:00 < 14:10 ≤ 14:20: rule (a) holds) and the marker (changesSince 14:10 = o1's first sighting: rule (b) fails). Not an orphan → no receipt.

Without the marker, o1 would be an orphan: rule (a) through acct-a's view, and no entry holding 10-02 09:00 began comparing at 14:10. Anchor 14:10 (§7): muse's session at 14:08 is within ±10 min (4000), idle [14:05, 14:12] covers [14:08, 14:10] (3000) → 7/10 ≥ 6/10 → a false UNASKED for an event already on the calendar (Hard Rule 7).

o2 'Team offsite' (10-03 12:00), first seen 14:20 by acct-a's pass: acct-a's entry followed changes since 09:00 < 14:20 ≤ 14:20, and no entry holding 10-03 12:00 began comparing at 14:20 → an orphan. Anchor 14:20: muse's session at 14:18 (4000), idle [14:15, 14:25] covers [14:18, 14:20] (3000) → 7/10 → UNASKED, reasons unasked.session, unasked.idle.
o2 finality (§7): muse's adapter synced 15:00 ≥ anchor + beforeClaimMin + graceMin = 14:52 → FINAL (evaluatedAt 15:30).
